title: License Key Formatting
description:
[Source: LeetCode 482]
You are given a license key represented as a string s that consists of only alphanumeric characters and dashes. Reformat string s so that each group contains exactly k characters (except for the first group which could be shorter), separated by dashes, and all lowercase letters are converted to uppercase.

Input Format:
First line: s
Second line: k

Output Format:
Reformatted string
